scriptLines:
query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(department AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS nombre_departamento
FROM silver.admissions
WHERE department IS NOT NULL',

query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(icd_code AS VARCHAR(50)) AS codigo_icd,
    CAST(CASE icd_code
        WHEN 'C50.911' THEN N'Neoplasia maligna de mama derecha'
        WHEN 'E11.9' THEN N'Diabetes mellitus tipo 2 sin complicaciones'
        WHEN 'F32.9' THEN N'Episodio depresivo mayor, no especificado'
        WHEN 'I10' THEN N'Hipertensión esencial (primaria)'
        WHEN 'J45.909' THEN N'Asma no especificada, sin complicaciones'
        WHEN 'K21.9' THEN N'Enfermedad por reflujo gastroesofágico'
        WHEN 'M54.5' THEN N'Lumbalgia (dolor lumbar)'
        WHEN 'N39.0' THEN N'Infección de vías urinarias'
        WHEN 'R51' THEN N'Cefalea (dolor de cabeza)'
        WHEN 'S72.001A' THEN N'Fractura de cuello de fémur derecho'
        ELSE N'Otra patología'
    END AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS descripcion_patologia,
    CAST(ISNULL(severity, 'Unknown') AS VARCHAR(50)) AS nivel_severidad
FROM silver.diagnoses
UNION ALL
SELECT
    CAST('N/A' AS VARCHAR(50)) AS codigo_icd,
    CAST(N'Sin Diagnóstico Registrado' AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS descripcion_patologia,
    CAST('Unknown' AS VARCHAR(50)) AS nivel_severidad',

query: 'SELECT
    CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), fecha, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_key,
    fecha AS fecha_completa,
    CAST(YEAR(fecha) AS SMALLINT) AS anio,
    CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, fecha) AS TINYINT) AS trimestre,
    CAST('T' + CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, fecha) AS VARCHAR(1)) AS VARCHAR(10)) AS trimestre_nombre,
    CAST(MONTH(fecha) AS TINYINT) AS mes,
    CAST(CASE MONTH(fecha)
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Enero' WHEN 2 THEN 'Febrero' WHEN 3 THEN 'Marzo'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Abril' WHEN 5 THEN 'Mayo' WHEN 6 THEN 'Junio'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Julio' WHEN 8 THEN 'Agosto' WHEN 9 THEN 'Septiembre'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'Octubre' WHEN 11 THEN 'Noviembre' WHEN 12 THEN 'Diciembre'
    END AS VARCHAR(20)) AS mes_nombre,
    CAST(CASE MONTH(fecha)
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Ene' WHEN 2 THEN 'Feb' WHEN 3 THEN 'Mar'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Abr' WHEN 5 THEN 'May' WHEN 6 THEN 'Jun'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Jul' WHEN 8 THEN 'Ago' WHEN 9 THEN 'Sep'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'Oct' WHEN 11 THEN 'Nov' WHEN 12 THEN 'Dic'
    END AS CHAR(3)) AS mes_corto,
    CAST(DATEPART(WEEK, fecha) AS TINYINT) AS semana_anio,
    CAST(DAY(fecha) AS TINYINT) AS dia_mes,
    CAST(((DATEPART(WEEKDAY, fecha) + @@DATEFIRST - 2) % 7) + 1 AS TINYINT) AS dia_semana,
    CAST(CASE ((DATEPART(WEEKDAY, fecha) + @@DATEFIRST - 2) % 7) + 1
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Lunes' WHEN 2 THEN 'Martes' WHEN 3 THEN 'Miércoles'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Jueves' WHEN 5 THEN 'Viernes' WHEN 6 THEN 'Sábado'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Domingo'
    END AS VARCHAR(20)) AS dia_nombre,
    CAST(CASE WHEN (((DATEPART(WEEKDAY, fecha) + @@DATEFIRST - 2) % 7) + 1) IN (6, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS es_fin_de_semana
FROM (
    SELECT admission_date AS fecha FROM silver.admissions WHERE admission_date IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT discharge_date AS fecha FROM silver.admissions WHERE discharge_date IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT payment_date AS fecha FROM silver.billing WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL
) AS f',

query: 'SELECT
    patient_id AS patient_id_bk,
    CAST(full_name AS NVARCHAR(250)) AS nombre_completo,
    CAST(ISNULL(gender, 'Otro') AS VARCHAR(20)) AS genero,
    date_of_birth AS fecha_nacimiento,
    CAST(CASE
        WHEN date_of_birth IS NULL THEN 'Desconocido'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE()) <= 18 THEN '0-18'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE()) <= 35 THEN '19-35'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE()) <= 60 THEN '36-60'
        ELSE '60+'
    END AS VARCHAR(50)) AS rango_etario,
    CAST(email AS VARCHAR(255)) AS correo_electronico,
    CAST(address AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS direccion,
    CAST(ISNULL(insurance_provider, 'Sin Seguro') AS NVARCHAR(150)) AS proveedor_seguro
FROM silver.patients',

query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(charge_type AS VARCHAR(100)) AS tipo_cargo,
    CAST(payment_status AS VARCHAR(50)) AS estado_pago
FROM silver.billing',

query: 'SELECT
    a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    dp.paciente_key,
    ddep.departamento_key,
    dd.diagnostico_key,
    CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), a.admission_date, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_ingreso_key,
    CASE
        WHEN a.discharge_date IS NOT NULL
            THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), a.discharge_date, 112) AS INT)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS fecha_alta_key,
    a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,
    CASE
        WHEN a.discharge_date IS NOT NULL
            THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS dias_estancia,
    CAST(1 AS INT) AS conteo_admisiones
FROM silver.admissions a
INNER JOIN gold.dim_paciente dp
    ON dp.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
INNER JOIN gold.dim_departamento ddep
    ON ddep.nombre_departamento = a.department
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        admission_id,
        icd_code,
        severity
    FROM (
        SELECT
            admission_id,
            icd_code,
            severity,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY admission_id ORDER BY diagnosis_id) AS rn
        FROM silver.diagnoses
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
) AS diag
    ON diag.admission_id = a.admission_id
INNER JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico dd
    ON dd.codigo_icd = ISNULL(diag.icd_code, 'N/A')
    AND dd.nivel_severidad = ISNULL(diag.severity, 'Unknown')',

query: 'SELECT
    b.billing_id AS billing_id_bk,
    b.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    dp.paciente_key,
    ddep.departamento_key,
    dsc.servicio_cargo_key,
    CASE
        WHEN b.payment_date IS NOT NULL
            THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), b.payment_date, 112) AS INT)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS fecha_pago_key,
    CAST(b.amount AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS monto_facturado,
    CAST(1 AS INT) AS conteo_transacciones
FROM silver.billing b
INNER JOIN silver.admissions a
    ON a.admission_id = b.admission_id
INNER JOIN gold.dim_paciente dp
    ON dp.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
INNER JOIN gold.dim_departamento ddep
    ON ddep.nombre_departamento = a.department
INNER JOIN gold.dim_servicio_cargo dsc
    ON dsc.tipo_cargo = b.charge_type
    AND dsc.estado_pago = b.payment_status',

query: 'SELECT
    CAST(admission_id AS INT) AS admission_id,
    CAST(patient_id AS INT) AS patient_id,
    admission_date,
    CASE
        WHEN discharge_date < admission_date THEN NULL
        ELSE discharge_date
    END AS discharge_date,
    CAST(department AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS department,
    CAST(attending_doctor_id AS INT) AS attending_doctor_id
FROM (
    SELECT
        LTRIM(RTRIM(a.admission_id)) AS admission_id,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(a.patient_id)) AS patient_id,
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(a.admission_date)), 23),
            TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(a.admission_date)), 101),
            TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(a.admission_date)), 10),
            TRY_PARSE(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.admission_date)) AS DATE USING 'en-US')
        ) AS admission_date,
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(a.discharge_date)), 23),
            TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(a.discharge_date)), 101),
            TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(a.discharge_date)), 10),
            TRY_PARSE(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.discharge_date)) AS DATE USING 'en-US')
        ) AS discharge_date,
        CASE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.department)))
            WHEN 'cardiology' THEN 'Cardiology'
            WHEN 'cardiolgy' THEN 'Cardiology'
            WHEN 'cardio' THEN 'Cardiology'
            WHEN 'emergency' THEN 'Emergency'
            WHEN 'emergancy' THEN 'Emergency'
            WHEN 'er' THEN 'Emergency'
            WHEN 'general surgery' THEN 'General Surgery'
            WHEN 'generalsurgery' THEN 'General Surgery'
            WHEN 'gen surg' THEN 'General Surgery'
            WHEN 'neurology' THEN 'Neurology'
            WHEN 'nuerology' THEN 'Neurology'
            WHEN 'neuro' THEN 'Neurology'
            WHEN 'oncology' THEN 'Oncology'
            WHEN 'oncologyy' THEN 'Oncology'
            WHEN 'onco' THEN 'Oncology'
            WHEN 'orthopedics' THEN 'Orthopedics'
            WHEN 'orthopaedics' THEN 'Orthopedics'
            WHEN 'ortho' THEN 'Orthopedics'
            WHEN 'pediatrics' THEN 'Pediatrics'
            WHEN 'paediatrics' THEN 'Pediatrics'
            WHEN 'peds' THEN 'Pediatrics'
            ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(a.department))
        END AS department,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(a.attending_doctor_id)) AS attending_doctor_id
    FROM bronze.admissions a
    INNER JOIN silver.patients p
        ON CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.patient_id)) AS INT) = p.patient_id
) AS t
WHERE admission_date IS NOT NULL',

query: 'SELECT
    CAST(billing_id AS INT) AS billing_id,
    CAST(admission_id AS INT) AS admission_id,
    CAST(charge_type AS VARCHAR(100)) AS charge_type,
    CAST(ROUND(parsed_amount, 2) AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS amount,
    CAST(payment_status AS VARCHAR(50)) AS payment_status,
    payment_date
FROM (
    SELECT
        LTRIM(RTRIM(b.billing_id)) AS billing_id,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(b.admission_id)) AS admission_id,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.charge_type)), ''), 'Other') AS charge_type,
        TRY_CAST(
            LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(b.amount, 'USD', ''), '$', ''), ',', '')))
            AS DECIMAL(18, 4)
        ) AS parsed_amount,
        CASE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.payment_status)))
            WHEN 'paid' THEN 'Paid'
            WHEN 'pending' THEN 'Pending'
            WHEN 'unpaid' THEN 'Unpaid'
            WHEN 'overdue' THEN 'Overdue'
            ELSE 'Pending'
        END AS payment_status,
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(b.payment_date)), 23),
            TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(b.payment_date)), 101),
            TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(b.payment_date)), 10),
            TRY_PARSE(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.payment_date)) AS DATE USING 'en-US')
        ) AS payment_date
    FROM bronze.billing b
    INNER JOIN silver.admissions a
        ON CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.admission_id)) AS INT) = a.admission_id
) AS t
WHERE parsed_amount IS NOT NULL
  AND parsed_amount > 0',

query: 'SELECT
    CAST(diagnosis_id AS INT) AS diagnosis_id,
    CAST(admission_id AS INT) AS admission_id,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN LEN(raw_icd) > 3 THEN LEFT(raw_icd, 3) + '.' + SUBSTRING(raw_icd, 4, LEN(raw_icd))
            ELSE raw_icd
        END AS VARCHAR(50)
    ) AS icd_code,
    CAST(diagnosis_description AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS diagnosis_description,
    CAST(severity AS VARCHAR(50)) AS severity
FROM (
    SELECT
        LTRIM(RTRIM(d.diagnosis_id)) AS diagnosis_id,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(d.admission_id)) AS admission_id,
        REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(
            CASE
                WHEN CHARINDEX(',', d.icd_code) > 0
                    THEN LEFT(d.icd_code, CHARINDEX(',', d.icd_code) - 1)
                ELSE d.icd_code
            END
        ))), '-', ''), '.', '') AS raw_icd,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(d.diagnosis_description)) AS diagnosis_description,
        CASE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.severity)))
            WHEN 'mild' THEN 'Mild'
            WHEN 'moderate' THEN 'Moderate'
            WHEN 'severe' THEN 'Severe'
            WHEN 'critical' THEN 'Critical'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS severity
    FROM bronze.diagnoses d
    INNER JOIN silver.admissions a
        ON CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.admission_id)) AS INT) = a.admission_id
) AS t',

query: 'SELECT
    CAST(patient_id AS INT) AS patient_id,
    CAST(full_name AS NVARCHAR(250)) AS full_name,
    CAST(gender AS VARCHAR(10)) AS gender,
    CASE
        WHEN parsed_dob < '1900-01-01' OR parsed_dob > '2026-11-22' THEN NULL
        ELSE parsed_dob
    END AS date_of_birth,
    CAST(phone AS VARCHAR(50)) AS phone,
    CAST(email AS VARCHAR(255)) AS email,
    CAST(address AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS address,
    CAST(insurance_provider AS NVARCHAR(150)) AS insurance_provider
FROM (
    SELECT
        LTRIM(RTRIM(patient_id)) AS patient_id,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(full_name, N'Â', N''))) AS full_name,
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(gender))) IN ('m', 'male') THEN 'Masculino'
            WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(gender))) IN ('f', 'female') THEN 'Femenino'
            ELSE 'Otro'
        END AS gender,
        CASE
            WHEN TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)), 23) IS NOT NULL
                THEN TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)), 23)
            WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)) LIKE '[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
                THEN TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)), 101)
            WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)) LIKE '[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(RIGHT(LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)), 2) AS INT) BETWEEN 28 AND 49
                        THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -100, TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)), 10))
                    ELSE TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)), 10)
                END
            ELSE TRY_PARSE(LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)) AS DATE USING 'en-US')
        END AS parsed_dob,
        CASE
            WHEN phone IS NULL OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(phone))) = 'unknown' THEN NULL
            ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(phone))
        END AS phone,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(email)), ' at ', '@'), 'gmial.com', 'gmail.com'), ',com', '.com'))
        END AS email,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(address)) AS address,
        CASE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(insurance_provider)))
            WHEN 'aetna' THEN 'Aetna'
            WHEN 'aetnaa' THEN 'Aetna'
            WHEN 'aetna inc.' THEN 'Aetna'
            WHEN 'bluecross' THEN 'BlueCross'
            WHEN 'blue cross' THEN 'BlueCross'
            WHEN 'blue-cross' THEN 'BlueCross'
            WHEN 'cigna' THEN 'Cigna'
            WHEN 'cigna health' THEN 'Cigna'
            WHEN 'medicaid' THEN 'Medicaid'
            WHEN 'medicare' THEN 'Medicare'
            WHEN 'medi-care' THEN 'Medicare'
            WHEN 'self pay' THEN 'Self-Pay'
            WHEN 'self-pay' THEN 'Self-Pay'
            WHEN 'unitedhealth' THEN 'UnitedHealth'
            WHEN 'united health' THEN 'UnitedHealth'
            WHEN 'uhc' THEN 'UnitedHealth'
            ELSE 'Sin Seguro'
        END AS insurance_provider,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(full_name, N'Â', N''))), date_of_birth, LTRIM(RTRIM(address))
            ORDER BY CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(patient_id)) AS INT)
        ) AS rn
    FROM bronze.patients
) AS t
WHERE rn = 1',
